name: testimonial-slider
title: Testimonial Slider
description: A single large testimonial on a dark panel: a circular avatar under a soft halo, a bold quote and a name with role. It rotates to the next quote on a timer, or by the round arrow buttons.
use: A landing or pricing page that needs one strong customer quote at a time without a wall of cards.
avoid: Auto-rotates every few seconds, so a slow reader may lose the quote, and it relies on remote avatar images.
a11y: Prev and next buttons have aria-labels, but the auto-rotation keeps changing the quote with no pause control and no reduced-motion check. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One testimonial fills a wide dark slate panel. At the top a small round portrait sits inside a faint radial halo, then a bold white quote over two or three lines, and under it a name and job title in italic. Round arrow buttons sit at the left and right edges.
behaves: Every few seconds the current quote and portrait fade out and the next slides in on a light rotate, with a brief crossfade between the two. Clicking the round arrows jumps forward or back, pauses the timer and later resumes it.
customise: Pass an array of testimonials with image, quote, name and role, plus autoRotate, duration and className; transition curves are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A few stacked nodes crossfading with CSS transitions and a timer; no canvas or loop.
